[[File:Iron warhammer detail.png|left|120px]]
The '''iron warhammer''' is a [[warhammer]] stronger than the [[bronze warhammer]]. It can be wielded at level 1 [[Strength]]. Players can make an iron warhammer with the [[Smithing]] [[skill]] at level 24 using 3 [[iron bar]]s, giving 75 Smithing [[experience]].

One spawns in the ruined castle near the bandits just south-west of the Hosidius [[Mess]].

The iron warhammer can be used as a substitute for a regular [[hammer]] when banging the big door at the entrance of [[Bandos' Stronghold]] in the [[God Wars Dungeon]].
